verdicts.tldr: the "after" pane renders the merge commit, so a realm master moved since the merge base shows master's change as the branch's
verdicts.details: The checkout step at 49-52 passes no `ref:`, so on a `pull_request` event actions/checkout takes the auto-generated `refs/pull/<N>/merge` — head merged into the current base tip — and the render step at 97-102 passes no `-root`, so findRoot resolves to that workspace tree while `-base-root` is the merge-base worktree from line 70. The header comment at 66-69 and renderBase's own comment at main.go:222-228 both assert the opposite, "the pair differs by the realm change alone, not by whatever else moved on master". The blast radius is narrower than the claim reads: the plan's file list (line 64) is merge-base..HEAD_SHA and stays correct, so the drift only shows where master touched a realm the plan already selected or one of its dependencies, and it costs the reviewer a misattributed pixel diff rather than a wrong realm list. Fix: pass `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}` on the checkout, which is also what makes the rendered tree match the sha the comment is about.
verdicts.evidence: Read, not run. pr-preview.yml:49-52 `- uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb... / with: fetch-depth: 0 / persist-credentials: false` — no `ref:`, which is the documented refs/pull/N/merge default for pull_request. pr-preview.yml:70 `git worktree add --detach "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" "$base"` with base=`git merge-base`. pr-preview.yml:97-102: render is called with -changed/-base-root/-out/-base-url/-pr and no -root, so main.go findRoot walks up from the workspace. main.go:224-228 states the invariant the wiring breaks.
verdicts.verify_by: in the render job, `git rev-parse HEAD` differs from $HEAD_SHA and `git rev-parse HEAD^1` is the base tip; locally `gh api repos/gnolang/gno/pulls/6194 --jq .merge_commit_sha` then `git log -1 --format=%P <that sha>`. Then render a PR whose base moved on a realm it also touches and compare the pair against `git diff <merge-base> <head> -- <that realm>`

verdicts.tldr: a changed path git has to quote is dropped from the plan, so its realm gets no preview page and nothing says so
verdicts.details: `git diff --name-only` C-quotes any path outside printable ASCII (core.quotePath defaults true) and always quotes one holding a quote, backslash or newline, writing `"examples/gno.land/r/x/caf/caf\303\251.gno"` into changed.txt. readLines (main.go:306-324) only does `strings.TrimSpace`, so the quotes survive, and both prefix tests in BuildPlan — the gnowebPaths loop at plan.go:212-216 and `strings.HasPrefix(f, pkgRoot+"/")` at plan.go:217 — fail against a string starting with `"`, dropping the file before byDir is consulted. Nothing reaches it today: `git ls-files examples/` is 1915 paths and none carries a byte outside 0x20-0x7e, which is why this is a latent risk rather than a live defect. Fix: `git -c core.quotePath=false diff --name-only`, or `-z` with a NUL split in readLines.
verdicts.evidence: Read plus the finder's git measurement, rechecked. plan.go:22 `pkgRoot = examplesRel + "/gno.land"`; plan.go:206 `f = filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimSpace(f))`; plan.go:217 `if !strings.HasPrefix(f, pkgRoot+"/") || !renderRelevant(f) { continue }`. Latency measured here: `git ls-files examples/ | LC_ALL=C grep -P '[^\x20-\x7e]'` returns nothing over 1915 tracked files.
verdicts.verify_by: in a scratch repo, commit a file whose name carries a non-ASCII byte and run `git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD`; then feed that exact line to `gnopreview plan -changed -` against a tree holding that realm and observe an empty realms list

verdicts.tldr: `make run` silently reuses a gnodev built from another branch, so the local preview can render code that is not on screen
verdicts.details: `$(GNODEV)` is a file target at the fixed path /tmp/gnodev (line 4) with no prerequisites, and make considers such a target up to date whenever the file exists, so the `go build -o $(GNODEV)` at line 21 runs exactly once per machine. A contributor who ran `make run` on one branch and then switches to a branch touching contribs/gnodev or gno.land/pkg/gnoweb gets a snapshot rendered by the stale binary with no line of output saying so — the same confusion main.go:222-228 argues the CI pair exists to remove, and CI is unaffected since pr-preview.yml:84-86 builds gnodev itself every run. The fixed /tmp path is also shared, so on a multi-user box the first user's binary is what every later `make run` executes. Fix: build into `$(OUT)/gnodev` or list the gnodev sources as prerequisites, so the binary is rebuilt when the tree it came from moves.
verdicts.evidence: Read, and the finder's `GNODEV=/tmp/gnodev-probe make -n run` rechecked against the file. Makefile:13 `run: $(GNODEV)`, Makefile:20-21 `$(GNODEV):` / `cd $(GNOROOT)/contribs/gnodev && go build -o $(GNODEV) .`, Makefile:4 `GNODEV  ?= /tmp/gnodev`. No .PHONY on $(GNODEV) (line 1 lists test run clean install only), so the existing-file rule applies.
verdicts.verify_by: `touch /tmp/gnodev-probe && GNODEV=/tmp/gnodev-probe make -n run` in misc/gnopreview - expect a gnodev build in the recipe, observe none

verdicts.tldr: after a docs-only or test-only push the preview comment keeps its links and its "rebuilt on every push" line while pointing at an older head
verdicts.details: The `paths:` filter at 17-26 gates the whole pipeline, and pr-preview-publish.yml fires only on `workflow_run: workflows: [pr / preview]`, so a push touching none of those paths starts no render, no publish and no comment update. The sticky comment from the last matching push therefore stands unchanged, still closing on comment.go:90, "Rebuilt on every push to this PR; removed when PR #%s closes.", while the reviewer opening its links sees realm pages built from a head the branch no longer has. The trigger is ordinary: any pull request that mixes a realm change with a later docs-only or test-only commit. Fix: put the head sha the snapshot was built from in the comment body, so a stale one is visible without the reviewer reconstructing the push history.
verdicts.evidence: Read, not run. pr-preview.yml:14-26 `on: pull_request: types:[opened,synchronize,reopened] paths:` listing examples/gno.land/**, gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/**, gno.land/cmd/gnoweb/**, contribs/gnodev/**, misc/gnopreview/**, .github/workflows/pr-preview.yml. pr-preview-publish.yml:20-23 `on: workflow_run: workflows: [pr / preview] types: [completed]`. comment.go:12 CommentMarker is what makes the comment sticky; comment.go:89-91 writes the closing sentence.
verdicts.verify_by: `sed -n '14,27p' .github/workflows/pr-preview.yml` for the filter, then on a pull request that already carries a preview comment push a docs-only commit and confirm no `pr / preview` check runs and the comment body is unchanged

verdicts.tldr: every closed pull request spends a runner and materialises the previews deploy key, almost always to find nothing to delete
verdicts.details: `pull_request_target: types: [closed]` at 12-14 carries no `paths:` filter, unlike pr-preview.yml, and the job's only gate is `vars.GNOWEB_PREVIEW_BASE_URL != ''` at line 31 — which is set on gnolang/gno itself, so a docs typo or a gnovm change closing also runs the job. It checks out gnolang/gno-previews with PREVIEWS_DEPLOY_KEY persisted on disk (39-44, the `artipacked` suppression acknowledging the persistence) and only then discovers at 56-58 that there is no pr-<N> and exits 0. The finder overstates the clone: fetch-depth defaults to 1, so it is a shallow checkout, but the working tree still materialises every live preview directory, and the standing cost is the credential being present in a job that, on most runs, has nothing to do — any step later added to it inherits that. Fix: give this workflow the same `paths:` filter pr-preview.yml carries, or read the previews repo for pr-<N> over the API before the deploy-key checkout.
verdicts.evidence: Read, not run. pr-preview-cleanup.yml:12-14 `on: pull_request_target: types: [closed]` — no paths key. Line 31 `if: vars.GNOWEB_PREVIEW_BASE_URL != ''` is the only guard. Lines 39-44 checkout with `repository: ${{ env.PREVIEWS_REPO }}` and `ssh-key: ${{ secrets.PREVIEWS_DEPLOY_KEY }}`, no persist-credentials: false. Lines 56-58 `if [ ! -d "pr-$PR" ]; then echo "no preview for PR #$PR — nothing to clean"; exit 0; fi` — after the checkout, not before.
verdicts.verify_by: `sed -n '12,16p' .github/workflows/pr-preview-cleanup.yml` - no paths filter; then `gh api 'repos/gnolang/gno/pulls?state=closed&per_page=100' --jq 'length'` against the count whose files match the pr-preview.yml filter, for the ratio of pointless runs
